title: Portable review-freeze instructions: how a parent and read-only reviewers prove the same input in any project, including staged changes and submodules
outcome: Portable review-freeze instructions: how a parent and read-only reviewers prove the same input in any project, including staged changes and submodules
acceptance: The portable Engram usage skill (docs/skills/engram-use/SKILL.md) has a short review-freeze section any consuming project can follow: the parent captures one identity and read-only reviewers check it at start and end, using only supported tools (TermAl termal_review_identity v1 capture/check, or plain Git identity: git write-tree plus read-only git diff/ls-files), with no project-specific digest scripts, git -c or git submodule commands
It states that different fingerprint schemas (a project's own digest, termal_review_identity v1, the launcher's source_id) are never compared with each other, and what each one is for

Staged, unstaged and untracked changes and submodules/gitlinks are covered, with the behavior verified on a real repository with a submodule (e.g. Questly's candidate) rather than assumed; any tool gap found is reported to its owner as a fix request
Questly can run its review round with the documented method

completion.summary: Published and installed the reviewed portable review-freeze instructions; the exact reviewed candidate is on origin/master and all four acceptance criteria have a fresh independent passing evaluation.
